newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrial average close Monday unofficial.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrial average close Monday unofficial.

text.p: Due to late trading in Philip Morris Cos Inc, the closing number for the Dow Jones Industrial Average was still unofficial at 1745 EDT/2145 GMT, Dow Jones said on Monday.
Trading in Philip Morris was halted late in the day pending news of a jury verdict in a tobacco liability suit. The halt was lifted shortly before the market's close.
At 1645 EST/2045 GMT, the New York Stock Exchange had put the Dow close at a 142.48-point gain to 7213.68, a record.
